scientific_integrity: The finite-dimensional combinatorial proof is included and a stand-alone direct group-multiplication checker is bundled. Finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof; historical-priority searches cannot guarantee uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Finite group labels and finite total transformations only; no triple products or arbitrary semigroup alphabets, and no growing-n uniform asymptotic. Historical priority concerning older skew-idempotent papers whose full texts were unavailable remains a risk.
title: One-sided product-idempotence rank spectra in finite group-labelled transformation monoids
